popup.characteristics_title: Articles & sites generated (in whole or in part) by AI share certain characteristics:
characteristics: typical GenAI expressions, patterns or hallucinations,
bylined to journalists with inhuman productivity,
translations and/or paraphrases of other articles (without citing them),
AI-generated images that do not meet journalistic standards,
filled with platitudes or moralizing rather than facts,
published on a site with no legal notice (or a fictitious one) and no editor-in-chief,
exploiting the reputation of "expired domain names",
copy/paste the same articles/information across many "copycat" sites/clones

alert_messages.genai:
This site is in Next.ink's French-language list of GenAI media.

The European Artificial Intelligence Regulation (AI Act) requires "synthetic" content to be identifiable as having been generated or manipulated by AI.

Based on human observations by Next.ink, most of the articles on this site appear to have been generated by AI (GenAI), without disclosing it.

For more information about our methodology, the number of flagged sites, to report other GenAI sites or flag any false positives, click on the extension button.

alert_messages.redflag: Warning: this site is in the Red Flag Domains database, an initiative that references potentially malicious domain names.
alert_messages.amf: Warning: this site is on the blacklist of companies and sites not authorised by the AMF (Autorité des marchés financiers).
alert_messages.dgccrf: Warning: this site appears on the DGCCRF digital requisition list (Direction générale de la concurrence, de la consommation et de la répression des fraudes).
alert_messages.idn_homograph:
Warning: this site uses IDN characters and may be malicious through a homograph attack.

Its domain name contains at least one homoglyph — a character that closely resembles another.

This may be legitimate (e.g. an accented character) but could also be malicious. In any case, be careful and verify which site you are on.

If this is a false positive, click the extension icon to report it.
